transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
Hello, doctor. For the past few years I feel worn out all the time, like I’m running on empty even when I’m not doing that much. It has just been really hard to keep going like this.
Have you also been experiencing feelings of sadness, hopelessness, or a lack of interest in activities you normally enjoy?

Yes, most days I feel this low, heavy, gray cloud over me, and everything feels completely joyless, even things I used to love like painting, hiking, and planning trips. I've also started to feel like this is just how my life is going to be from now on, and that nothing is really going to change it.
Can you tell me how long you've been experiencing these feelings of sadness and lack of interest, and have they been constant or have you had any periods where you felt significantly better?

This gray, heavy feeling has been with me steadily for a little over three years, starting right around the time my company did a major restructuring. It has been very constant, and even when we've gone on vacations or trips abroad, I haven't felt any better or been able to find my usual joy.
Have you experienced any periods, even brief ones, where your mood improved significantly for at least two months since this all started, or has it been a persistent low mood the entire time?

No, I haven't had any breaks from this feeling at all; it has been a persistent low mood the entire time. I haven't had even a single week where I felt significantly better, let alone two months. It has just been a steady, heavy cloud for the last three years.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight, appetite, sleep patterns, or energy levels over the past three years, and if so, how have they changed?

My energy levels have been extremely low for the past three years; even after a full night's sleep, I feel completely drained, like my body is filled with sand. I haven't noticed any significant changes in my weight or appetite, but this constant lack of energy makes it hard to do basic tasks or enjoy my hobbies.
You mentioned that everything feels joyless, but can you tell me if there are any specific activities or situations where you still feel some pleasure or interest, even if it's fleeting?

No, there really aren't any activities that bring me pleasure anymore. Even my favorite pastimes like hiking, painting, photographing the Temecula hills, or planning trips feel completely flat and joyless now. Just trying to do them feels like a heavy chore rather than something I can actually enjoy.
Do you often feel guilty or worthless, or have recurring thoughts that you're a burden to others or that you've let them down in some way?
I don't really feel that way, to be honest. I haven't experienced strong feelings of guilt or worthlessness, or felt like I'm a burden to others.
Have you had any previous episodes of depression before this three-year period, or is this the first time you've experienced such a prolonged low mood?
No, I don't recall ever feeling this way before this recent period. This is definitely the first time I've experienced such a prolonged, steady low mood in my life.

You've mentioned that activities you used to enjoy now feel joyless, but can you think of any instances, no matter how small, where you felt even a slight spark of pleasure or interest in something over the past three years?

No, I really can't think of a single instance where I felt any spark. Even during trips abroad or visits to wine country—things that used to bring me so much excitement—I just felt completely flat and disengaged. Even photographing the Temecula hills or planning our outings hasn't brought me any pleasure at all.
Can you think of any small pleasures, like enjoying a favorite meal, a warm bath, or a good book, that you still find some enjoyment in, even if it's not as fulfilling as it used to be?

Honestly, even small things like that feel completely joyless and gray to me right now. Hobbies I used to love, like painting, hiking, or taking photos of the hills, just feel like way too much effort. They don't bring me any of the warmth or pleasure they used to, and everything just feels flat.

You've had a persistent low mood for three years without any significant improvement, but can you recall if there were any brief periods, even just a few days, where you felt nearly back to your normal self or had a notable increase in energy and interest in activities?

No, I haven't had any periods where I felt back to my normal self or had an increase in energy. Even during vacations to wine country or trips abroad, I still felt the exact same low, flat way. I just couldn't find my usual energy or enjoyment at all.

Can you confirm if you've had any periods, regardless of how brief, where you felt significantly better or had a notable improvement in your mood and energy levels since the onset of these symptoms three years ago?

No, I can confirm that I haven't had any periods of better energy or mood at all over the last three years. This heavy, flat feeling has been completely steady and constant, and even when taking vacations or trips abroad, I still felt drained and unable to enjoy them.
